sonnet.problem: Stop 2 uses a junk drawer joke twice, on card 6 ("After years in a dark junk drawer...") and again on card 17 ("An angel once found me in the back of a junk drawer...").
sonnet.rule: His drawer years carry a joke at most once per stop.

sonnet.problem: The two wrong answers, "The good works we have done" and "Our careful obedience", mean nearly the same thing, so they are near-matches of each other.
sonnet.rule: Two wrong answers never mean the same as each other either.

sonnet.problem: The question says "this grace" without saying what grace it means. It points back to a card the baker can't see on screen.
sonnet.rule: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

sonnet.problem: In "how much Onesiphorus ministered to him," the word "him" could mean Timothy or Paul. A baker could read it as Timothy and mark the true statement false.
sonnet.rule: "He," "she" and "they" always point to someone the baker can tell.
